notes.title: THE GYM BROS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I am thrilled to announce the release of the first major update to the game! This update includes multiple balance fixes, as well as exciting new content and features.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
This update introduces the ability to recruit "gym bros," which allows you to unlock more biceps to workout at the same time. This leads to increased volume and repetition points. Additionally, we have added two new ascension perks that boost and prolong the salt effect.

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]
You can now customize the appearance of your arms with "skins." There are four skins available from the start, with an additional three to be unlocked by recruiting new gym bros.

[h2]Future Updates[/h2]
I have plans for a future update focused on customization. This update will include a Steam Workshop feature that allows you to create and share your own custom skins for arms and weights, among other exciting tweaks.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
There have been significant changes to the game's balance, particularly with regard to ascension prices and effects. These are now exponential, making the late game more engaging. Straps are no longer useless in the late game, and salt is now more powerful, with the ability to be upgraded with ascension points.

Thank you for playing the game, I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Second Minor Update
notes.notes:
This update fixes and adds a few things.

New Feature:
[list]
[*]Some of you have requested a window mode, that has been added to the game, you can toggle between, borderless, window, and fullscreen mode. You can do so from the settings menu, or by pressing "F" on the keyboard.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]There has been a correction of a visual bug where the amount of R/S and KG/S was misscalculated
[*]Fixex the leaderboards position bug
[*]Improved menu navigation by being able to close any menu by clicking outside the banner
[*]Balance update for price and effect of the 3 volume upgrades (might change again based on late game behaviour)
[/list]

Finally I wanted to talk about cheaters and the leaderboard, I have banned a few users from posting their scores on the leaderboard (users that were clearly cheating). I do not have any problem with autoclickers or even cheating as long as it doesn't affect other players, in this case, the leaderboard ranking. I do not see a clear solution for this issue, and will explore other possibilities in the future.


That's all for now, 
Thanks again for all the support for this game, I am really happy with the launch

I have also added a "bug report" button and "idea button" on the settings menu. If you find any issue, bug, the game doesn't behave as you think it should, don't hesitate in reporting it here:

For the "idea button", this is aimed at game improvements, game suggestions or even a hole new idle clicker game you think could be cool, open to ideas, I want to make this game a great game, and with your help and your feedback I think we can do it.
